text: Materials science and engineering is an interdisciplinary field that studies the composition, structure, properties, preparation processes, and applications of materials. The core logic is to reveal the intrinsic connections among "composition - structure - process - performance - application", and to optimize the macroscopic properties by regulating the microstructure of materials, thereby meeting the functional requirements of different scenarios. From daily-used mobile phone screens, automotive steel plates, to aerospace high-temperature-resistant alloys, semiconductor materials for chips, and battery electrode materials in the field of new energy, almost all technological breakthroughs rely on the progress of materials science. Therefore, it is called "the cornerstone of industry" and "the forerunner of high-tech".
